name: capital-stack-finterminal-web
description: Capital-Stack-FinTerminal web (#1351, design 3.5): the FinTerm pages of the SvelteKit webapps site served as static files behind the shared c3-pvt gate (Authelia 2FA session or fleet bearer) at c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/capital-stack-finterminal-web/. Same origin as c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/capital-stack-finterminal-api, so the page reads the /v1 API with the gate's session: no CORS, no token in the page. Built by cloudy-h-webapps-mob (ghcr.io/diegonmarcos/capital-stack-finterminal-web). LOCAL, not for deploy until the owner approves.

deploy._host_doc: oci-apps, beside capital-stack-finterminal-api: reached at capital-stack-finterminal-web.mesh.diegonmarcos.com over wg0, and publicly only at c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/capital-stack-finterminal-web behind the shared gate (#1104). No per-app public host.

finterm._doc: The page base path is the c3-pvt route of this container (/capital-stack-finterminal-web); the API it reads same-origin is the c3-pvt route of the api container.
